FILM 10.sentiment: Students like the selection of early films and the enthusiastic, kind teaching. Many complain about disorganized lectures, unclear instructions, trivia-style weekly quizzes, very late grading and little guidance on papers and the final. Several reviewers found the class stressful, though some call it easy.
